Open-source content aggregator and RSS reader Chaski has released version 0.9.1 by developer a-chacon.

Designed for 64-bit Windows 10/11, Linux, and macOS, the software emphasizes local privacy with no ads, tracking, or data leaving the user's device.

Key features include auto-discovery of RSS and Atom feeds, OPML import and export, account and folder organization, customizable filters, and both dark and light modes.
